name_reason: Fully compliant game-global name: data_fd2_ prefix; audio domain (it is an SFX handle bank for sound playback); figani descriptor (extracted from a FIGANI.DAT animation byte stream via fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank); sfx_bank descriptor names the contents; buf_ptr reflects the data type (a heap buffer pointer). No Ghidra address residue -- 'figani' is the FIGANI.DAT resource domain term, not a hex address. Name correctly conveys both purpose and that it is a pointer.
purpose: Runtime heap pointer to the SFX handle bank extracted from a FIGANI animation byte stream (the return value of fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank), used to play per-pose sound effects during FIGANI cinematic overlays.
logic_summary: Mutable .bss pointer, zero at rest. Each of the three FIGANI cinematic players assigns it the return of fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank(figani_buf) before any read, passes it by value as the bank handle to fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(bank, sfx_id, 1) on per-pose SFX hook bytes, then on cleanup calls fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(bank, -1, 1) to stop all SFX and frees it when non-NULL. fd2_play_figani_animation_loop is a 4th site that only READS it (same pass-by-value-to-fd2_play_sfx_with_handle usage). Accessed as a full 32-bit pointer (MOV dword) at every site, never indexed locally.
datatype: uint32 (heap pointer to an SFX handle bank; opaque buffer, declared as uint32 holding the address)
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer value -- the base address of the FIGANI-derived SFX bank that fd2_play_sfx_with_handle treats as its bank handle. Not an array/table; never indexed at any access site.
